tagline: Your team of AI agents, living in the notch
brief: A macOS notch app where developers and non-developer entrepreneurs build a team of AI agents on Claude Code or Codex. Each agent has a face, a name and a job; they work, ask before acting, sleep and wake.
criteria: Away from the plain honeycomb and robot-head clichés, readable in the menu bar, works in one colour, reflects a team of agents.

concepts.name: Team stack
concepts.idea: Three agent cells stacked like the avatars in the collapsed notch — a hive is a team.
rationale: Mirrors the product: the notch shows your working agents exactly like this
Front cell is the one at work; the ones behind are ready
Real cut-out gaps, so it works in one colour, reversed and at menu-bar size

recommendation: Team stack — chosen. Honey front cell on graphite, with two deeper honey tones for depth.
next_steps: Apply to the app icon, menu bar, notch and board
Use the stack as the loading/working motif
